---
description: Clarify a user story and create approved requirements.
mode: agent
---

Read the supplied user story and `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. Identify
ambiguous requirements and ask the user focused questions before choosing
behavior. After answers, create `/docs/requirements.md` with functional and
non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, constraints, and explicit
out-of-scope items. Never guess; use `Not Found` for missing facts. Do not
implement code in this step.
